title: deutzia crenata f. plena
intro: Deutzia crenata f. plena, commonly known as the variegated deutzia or the double-lobed deutzia, is a flowering plant in the hydrangea family (Hydrangeaceae). This plant is known for its fragrant, white, and double flowers that bloom in the late spring and early summer. The health benefits of Deutzia crenata f. plena include its potential to aid in stress relief and sleep improvement, due to its sedative and calming effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
